messages:
maya: deploy-bot started staged rollout v3.2.0 -> canary 4% (us-west-2). change window until 14:30 UTC. watching generate/embeds paths :eyes:
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: v3.2.0 -> canary=4% | regions=[us-west-2] | changelist=CL#5377
rahul: seeing a small spike in 429s for long-running streaming sessions routed to canary, started ~t+5m. overall rate ~0.4% -> 2.1%
devon: link: https://telemetry.redwood/reqset/5377-streams  sample shows client connections reset during prefix-extension calls
sre-bot: kube events: pod/inf-canary-c-3 reported "evicting idle conns" logs around same time, node socket exhaustion hints
maya: build notes show we upgraded connection pool settings (keepalive idle -> 10s) in this runtime to be more aggressive under load. maybe too aggressive for some SDK versions
rahul: quick repro: run 100 parallel long streams against canary, many abort with early resets. repro script: ```./repro_stream.sh --env=canary --concurrency=100 --duration=90s```
devon: ops: can we freeze progression? I prefer stall at 4% and avoid automated ramp to 10%
maya: agreed. @deploy-bot hold progression and add changelog note: "hold: transient stream resets / 429s on canary due to connection pool tuning"
deploy-bot: action queued: freeze rollout progression. canary remains at 4%. notify: #eng-oncall #eng-releases #devex
rahul: mitigation options: (1) revert keepalive tuning to previous defaults (fast config pin CL#5378), (2) temporarily increase ws/socket limits on nodes, (3) route streaming traffic away from canary via traffic shaping
devon: (1) seems fastest. CL#5378 will flip keepalive back to 60s and rebuild image. ETA ~9m for bake
maya: also want to avoid autoscaler interference; pause autoscaler on canary pool while we validate
sre-bot: autoscaler hold applied for group=inf-canary-usw2 for 25m
rahul: QA/devex: please run streaming compatibility matrix against pinned image after deploy. test matrix link: https://docs.redwood/internal/stream-matrix
devon: merging CL#5378 now after quick +1 from infra lead. merging... :hammer_and_wrench:
maya: image rolled: inf-runtime:keepalive-60-5378 -> pods restarting rolling. expected per-pod restart ~30-45s
rahul: quick smoke: ran repro with concurrency=100 for 3m against pinned image; 429s back to baseline, no resets observed in sample window
devon: extended run planned 20m. if stable, we resume to 12% then continue normal ramp. if regressions return, rollback to v3.1.9 full
maya: consensus: hold at 4%, pin to previous keepalive, validate extended run. thumbs? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
rahul: :+1:
devon: :+1:
maya: will update release notes: add "hold: stream resets on canary; reverted keepalive tuning (CL#5378); extended validation" and mark incident_candidate if we roll back
deploy-bot: note recorded: rollout_frozen=true | changelog_note_added=true
sre-bot: monitoring hooks adjusted: stream-reset alert threshold lowered for canary group during validation
maya: tagging for postmortem if we perform rollback. everyone stand by for extended run results and any outliers posted here.
